about: GTA 6 settings, fact-checked (Delta). A viral TikTok (@wasted.clips_, 2026-11-19, topic only, no footage) gives four Display tips: Motion Blur Strength 0; Player Status / Hit / Awareness Effects Intensity 5 to 2; HDR Calibration numbers (Max Brightness 600, Black Levels 50, Paper White 50); Brightness Reduction ON. Our verdicts: blur - GTA 6 targets 30 fps on consoles (Rockstar via PC Gamer 2026-11-10), default 3 of max 10; 0 is sharp but can judder at 30 fps (Gamerbolt), a PC Gamer hardware editor picked 1 on the standard PS5 (PC Gamer 2026-11-19), verdict TEST 0 vs 1; effects - taste, keep; HDR - Max Brightness should match your TV (Gamerbolt), never copy numbers; Brightness Reduction - Off by default (playday.one, gamer.org), comfort option, our pick: leave off. Own drawn menu only, tagged OUR DRAWING. Sources in BRIEF.md.
